scope: Offline ML and cached local-game contextual-bandit experiments; no active bot changes/uploads.
selection: Twenty strongest half-cohort opponents, four largest-deficit maps per opponent; intentionally heavy-loss-biased, not population-representative. Add20 current rank1 games as separate unseen-teacher imitation holdout.
features: Personal API observations at own turn start only; IDs, source names, match outcomes, future actions and map names excluded from model features. History updates only from already observed frames.
MLTargets: Next visible enemy approach / unchanged-distance / retreat, with and without observed history
Expert own-turn action category; behavioral imitation is not an optimal-action or win-rate claim.
evaluation: Opponent-disjoint train/validation/test; rank1 teacher entirely separate. Report macro-F1, balanced accuracy, per-game accuracy and class prevalence. No random-frame split. No per-frame accuracy claim of strategy improvement.
RL: Offline single-decision contextual bandit (REINFORCE) choosing v57 or Vesper-funnel at draft, from paired cached whole-game engine outcomes. Not multi-turn PPO. Group holdout maps and reserve opponent controllers. Compare fixed policies and random mixture.
deployment: Any predictive gain requires a subsequent policy/in-engine trial; do not upload an offline accuracy result.
